description: Runs the 60-rule vibe-shield scanner over a project directory or a set of paths and returns the grade, score and every finding with its exact file, line, CWE and remediation steps. Call this after writing or modifying application code — API routes, server actions, database migrations, auth logic, environment variables, LLM calls or webhook handlers — and before reporting a task as complete. Also call it when the user asks for a security review or audit.

includeTests.description: Include test, spec and fixture files.

limit.description: Maximum findings to return in the text summary. Default 25, 0 for all.

paths.description: Explicit files or directories to scan, instead of the whole project.

rules.description: Restrict to these rule ids or prefixes, e.g. ["VSB-CLIENT-001"] or ["VSB-DB-*"].

severity.description: Only return findings at or above this severity.

target.description: Directory or file to scan. Relative paths resolve against the server working directory. Default: the working directory.

name: vibe_shield_scan
title: Scan a project for AI-introduced security bugs
